versions.content: Service Name E2E_ P04m Map Status To SM Syntax E2E_ PCheck Status Type E2E_ P04m Map Status To SM ( Std_ Return Type Check Return, E2E_ P04m Check Status Type Status ) Service ID [hex] 0x45 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Check Return Return value of the E2E_ P0 4m Sink Check/ E2E_ P04m Source Check function Status Status determined by E2E_ P04m Sink Check/ E2E_ P04m Source Check function Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value E2 E _ P Check Status - Type Profile - independent status of the reception on one single Data in one cycle. Description The function maps the check status of Profile 4m to a generic check status, which can be used by E2E state machine check function. The E2E Profile 4m delivers a more fine - granular status, but this is not relevant for the E2E state machine. Available via E2E.h
